<thought>To obtain realistic template IDs I will query the template catalog for each of the six required transformations, using the functional‑group names from the available list. I will search for (1) sulfonamide formation (break acyl‑chloride, form sulfonamide), (2) intramolecular flavanone cyclisation (break ketone, form ether oxygen and C‑C bond), (3) nucleophilic aromatic substitution (break aryl‑halide, form C‑N), (4) nitro reduction (break nitro, form primary amine), (5) carbamate formation (break acyl‑chloride, form carbamate), and (6) piperazine alkylation (break alkyl‑halide, form tertiary amine). After retrieving suitable template IDs I will construct the JSON retrosynthesis route with exactly six reaction nodes.</thought>
